analyzed: yaḥ jñāna puṇya ubhaya saṃbhṛtaḥ san
jñātvā avatīrya api ca deva lokāt
kukṣim viśantam gaja vat hi māyā
śākya ātmajam vai daśa māsa pūrtau
brahma indra vandyam vara lakṣaṇam ca
matvā udyamena eva hi bodhi siddhim
guṇaiḥ pradarśya tri bhave atula arham
samyak tayā santam api hi amartyam
samasta sattva ācaraṇam hi api idam
